summary: Synthetic demo: a red block runs four 4-second legs between two cones. Two of its three turns stall for 1.5 s at the right cone; the turn at the left cone takes 0.5 s.

moments.what: 04.0-05.5: stops at the right cone for 1.5 s before running back
moments.why: likely arrives at full speed and has to stop dead before it can turn

moments.what: 09.5-10.0: turns at the left cone in 0.5 s
moments.why: keeps moving through the turn; the model to copy

moments.what: 14.0-15.5: again a 1.5 s stall at the right cone
moments.why: same pattern as 00:04: a habit, not a one-off

moments.what: steady speed over the whole leg, no slowdown before the cone
moments.why: pace is even; only the turns lose time
